lines.text: Friend. Friends. Hands where I can see them, mine are visible, and look: no weapons. Broker's flag. Truce. Knock on wood.
Broker. Claims broker. The poacher is on leave.
He knocked on the cart. Twice.

choice.text: State your claim and your terms. I will listen.
I could report you to the Warden right now.

lines.text: A gentleman. Salvage rights on the wreck of the Red Span. Cut stone under it. I can show you.
You could. Then nobody gets the stone and nobody gets paid. Think it over.
